text: SetContentType copies the input then truncates at the first semicolon. SetContentTypeParam strips leading semicolons and spaces from a nonempty input into the separate field. Preserve this local split when constructing attachment MIME values; the setter does not parse arbitrary MIME parameter syntax or quoted values. title: Keep attachment content type and parameters separate
